Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as its ingredients.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Cream of Vegetable Soups are made in [[Cooking Pot]]s by combining [[Fresh Milk]], [[Rock Salt]], and any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]]. This [[Recipe]], however, excludes [[Endura Carrot]]s, [[Swift Carrot]]s, and [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, otherwise the resulting dish will be [[Veggie Cream Soup]]. Eating them can heal between seven to ten of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s, depending on the [[Ingredient]]s used. They also sell between 40 to 60 [[Rupee]]s. Cream of Vegetable Soups are healthy dishes, made by simmering Vegetables in milk. Based on the type of Ingredients used, several different variations of Cream of Vegetable Soup can be made: * '''Hearty Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. These soups completely refill Link's Hearts when eaten and will temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. They also sell for 70 Rupees. * '''Energizing Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by including [[Courser Bee Honey]] or other energizing Ingredients in the recipe. When eaten, Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be partially refilled. They restore seven Hearts, and they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Hasty Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Cream of Mushroom Soup}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Swift Violet]]s or other speed-increasing Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's movement speed. These soups heal one Heart and sell for 40 Rupees. * '''Spicy Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Grants a low-level cold resistance.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Warm Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. If eaten, they grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] for a short period of time. They replenish one Heart and sell for 20 Rupees. * '''Electro Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Grants a low-level electricity resistance.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Electric Safflina]]s or other electricity-related Ingredients. When eaten, Link will be granted one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. They'll heal Link for one Heart and sell for 20 Rupees. * '''Mighty Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Thistle]]s or other mighty Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's attack power. They also heal one Heart, and they sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Tough Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Armoranth]]s or other tough Ingredients. When eaten, they'll increase Link's defense for a short time. They replenish one of Link's Hearts, and they sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's [[Stealth]]. They replenish one Heart and sell for 20 Rupees. * '''Chilly Cream of Vegetable Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Cream of Vegetable Soup}}
Grants mid-level heat resistance.
Made by simmering vegetables in milk, this healthy dish is as simple as the ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Cool Safflina]]s or other chilly Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. They heal one of Link's Heart and sell for 20 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cream of Mushroom Soup * Food * Meal * Veggie Cream Soup }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Soups |items= BotW, TotK }}
